pending_editorial.reason: primary evidence unresolved: HTTP Error 404: Not Found; agiresearch/LiteCUA still returns 404 from the GitHub API and its README endpoint, with no redirect, although the AIOS README still links it as the LiteCUA codebase. The Cerebrum README says LiteCUA has been integrated into Cerebrum, the AIOS agent SDK (agiresearch/Cerebrum), which needs its own proposal and review. The paper (arxiv:2505.18829) is curated separately; do not infer a release at this path.

pending_editorial.name: Project Mariner
pending_editorial.reason: The Project Mariner page on labs.google.com is a client-rendered sign-in shell whose HTML carries only the title, and the former deepmind.google Project Mariner pages now redirect to the DeepMind homepage. Approval needs a readable first-party product page.

pending_editorial.name: On-Device Language Models: A Comprehensive Review
pending_editorial.reason: This survey covers on-device language-model architectures, compression and deployment. Further review is needed to establish substantive computer-interface-agent coverage.

pending_editorial.name: Small Language Models are the Future of Agentic AI
pending_editorial.reason: This is a general position on small language models in agentic architectures. The abstract does not establish a specific computer-interface application for adjacent inclusion.

pending_editorial.name: An Information Theoretic Perspective on Agentic System Design
pending_editorial.reason: The abstract studies compressor-predictor language-model systems and Deep Research. A concrete connection to GUI, browser or operating-system interaction needs further primary-source review.

pending_editorial.name: Rethinking Scale: Deployment Trade-offs of Small Language Models under Agent Paradigms
pending_editorial.reason: The abstract compares base models, tool-equipped agents and multi-agent systems without identifying interface-interaction tasks. Retain as metadata pending a task-level scope check.

pending_editorial.name: HazardAuditor: From Executable Threats to Safer Computer-Use Agents
pending_editorial.reason: The abstract trains safety guards from normalized events across Claude Code, Codex, Hermes and OpenClaw. Browser interaction appears in the general motivation, but it does not identify actual GUI/browser tasks or the execution interface of its evaluated benchmarks. Harness names and the computer-use label alone do not establish material GUI evidence.

pending_editorial.name: AgentAttack
pending_editorial.reason: Reviewer hold: the retained README accompanies a conceptual position paper and lists related work; the official repository tree contains a README, two images, and .DS_Store, with no executable benchmark or test dataset. Do not classify this bibliography as a released benchmark.

pending_editorial.name: Agent-SafetyBench
pending_editorial.reason: Reviewer hold: this release evaluates general tool-using agents in JSON-schema/Python simulated environments. The retained README and paper Sections 3.2.1 and Appendix C do not establish direct GUI or browser execution for this benchmark. Keep the source and receipt pending an explicit adjacent-scope justification.

pending_editorial.name: PrivacyLens: Evaluating Privacy Norm Awareness of Language Models in Action
pending_editorial.reason: Reviewer hold: the retained abstract and full-text Sections 3.2–3.3 describe ToolEmu/GPT-4-emulated tool trajectories and final-action privacy evaluation. They do not establish direct GUI or browser interaction for this method. Preserve the bibliographic record as metadata-only pending an explicit adjacent-scope justification.

pending_editorial.name: Progent: Securing AI Agents with Privilege Control
pending_editorial.reason: Reviewer hold: the retained abstract and full-text Sections 8–9 evaluate typed tool-call policies on AgentDojo/ASB and MCP integrations. Section 9 explicitly excludes graphical-interface tool calls from the current method. Preserve the bibliographic record as metadata-only; do not describe this as a web/GUI defense.
